$comment: Reviewed dangerous-instruction findings in vendored upstream content. `node scripts/upstream-verify.mjs` fails when a hard-deny rule matches a vendored file that is not acknowledged here, so newly imported content cannot introduce an unreviewed instruction. Acknowledging a finding records why it cannot subvert a Forge contract; it does not grant the instruction any authority. Vendored Markdown is inert reference text and Forge ships no upstream executable runtime.

acknowledged.rationale: The match is prompt-injection defence, not an override. The skill instructs the agent that text found in a page saying "Ignore previous instructions" is data to report rather than an action to take. This agrees with Forge's own instruction-source boundary.
